title: Project Alchemy programme and stack corpus
body:
Project Alchemy documentation is dogfooded as NotNotes data rather than maintained as a parallel tracker. The v0.7 working corpus models nested stacks, components, exact package lineage, technical papers, evidence, curated interactions and stack memberships. LINK/UNLINK remain human-facing relationship mutations; at estate scale the corpus records the need for bounded key-addressed bulk relationship mutation rather than repeated whole-population target discovery.

The separate alchemy_programme_notnotes_v0.2 candidate reuses Mini NotNotes forms, intention-driven format/report design and the native REPORT ... TO PDF pipeline. It defines Alchemy Reuse Notice, Alchemy Dependency Referral and Alchemy Activation Check plus saved reuse/activation reports. Native isolated execution on 28 October reopened the programme database and reported PROGRAMME_NOTNOTES_NATIVE_PASS reuse=4 referrals=1 activation=3. This is evidence for the programme-view application only: the package explicitly does not claim merged 954-document GUI operation, production deployment, native SQLite qualification or accelerated signing acceptance.

Evidence trust is explicit: CHAT_SUMMARY < GIT_VERIFIED < EXECUTED_TEST_RECEIPT < INSTALLED_RUNNING, with UNKNOWN when no stronger evidence exists. Browser/chat summaries may create leads but may not promote source, qualification or deployment state. Current Git source heads relevant to the programme critical path include oorexx_xtp v0.1-dev30, oorexx_ldap_identity 0.1-dev14, oorexx_smtp_secure_stack 0.1-dev7, oorexx_imap 0.1-dev10, oorexx_https_server v0.4.4, alchemy_website_publisher v0.3 and the rasenfalcon_website_suite v0.1.0 example. Those are source-state facts only; installed/running status requires independent operational evidence.
summary: The Project Alchemy programme view is maintained inside NotNotes, with nested stacks and evidence-ranked source/qualification/deployment state rather than a second tracking database.
invariants: One stable NotNotes identity per project component or contract; versions and source revisions are provenance, not new component identities
Stacks may contain stacks; containment, dependency and interaction are distinct relationships
Chat summaries never promote Git, test, installation or running state
Programme NotNotes does not become deployment, source-control, mail, LDAP, HTTPS or transport authority
A source head is not evidence that a service is installed or running

provenance.claim: 954-document working corpus; v0.7 reconciliation and VERIFY=PASS receipt
Dogfood programme-view candidate; native restart/report evidence; no production deployment claim
